description: Benchmark action catalog for local validation before dispatch to OCUDU runtime interfaces. Action type names are benchmark API contracts; raw wire command names such as rrm_policy_ratio_set, ssb_set, and metrics_subscribe are not task action types.

actions.description: Only accepted action in the v1 skeleton. Runtime OCUDU actions are added in later stages.
WebSocket PRB policy action used by PRB-control tasks. Min/max ratios are scored; dedicated ratio is validity-only.
E2SM-CCC cell/slice PRB policy action using OCUDU's O-RRMPolicyRatio control payload. Min/max ratios are scored; dedicated ratio is validity-only.
actions.wire_command: E2SM-CCC O-RRMPolicyRatio via FlexRIC control xApp

actions.description: E2SM-RC DU control style 2 action 6 PRB quota action. The benchmark discovers DU UE identity when the action omits du_ue_id.

constraints.du_ue_id: optional non-negative integer when supplied by the agent

actions.wire_command: E2SM-RC DU control style 2 action 6 via FlexRIC control xApp

actions.description: OCUDU WebSocket SSB block-power action using the native ssb_set command. This is scored for validation and command-path correctness, not RF effect in ZMQ.
